steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Change the default event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title using an automatically generated unique title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Select the product's mapped variant.
Set the requested delivery location.
Open the terms and conditions attachment modal.
Attach the closest supported PDF fixture in place of the unavailable terms.pdf.
Confirm the uploaded PDF is shown in the attachment UI.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Add one available QA vendor to the event.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Check that the published project details expose a download control for the attachment.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open this event in the vendor's overview so its shared documents can be checked.
Confirm the vendor view exposes a document download control.
Have the vendor download the attached PDF.
Assert that the vendor download completed.
